entries.title: Iron Man
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: May 2, 2008 · Phase 1 · Set in: 2008 (Marvel's 2023 official timeline; older charts say 2010)
entries.story: Tony Stark, a genius billionaire weapons maker, is ambushed and kidnapped in Afghanistan by the Ten Rings terrorist group, who order him to build them a missile. Instead, with fellow prisoner Ho Yinsen, he builds an arc reactor to keep shrapnel out of his heart and a crude armored suit to escape. Back home, shaken by seeing his own weapons used against innocent people, Tony shuts down Stark Industries' weapons division and secretly perfects a sleek, flying Iron Man suit. He discovers that his business partner Obadiah Stane has been selling weapons to terrorists and arranged the kidnapping; Stane steals Tony's arc reactor to power his own giant suit, the Iron Monger, and Tony defeats him with help from his assistant Pepper Potts. At a press conference the next day, Tony throws away his cover story and announces, "I am Iron Man." The film introduces S.H.I.E.L.D. through Agent Phil Coulson.
credits: Post-credits: Nick Fury (Samuel L. Jackson) appears in Tony's living room and tells him he is not the only superhero in the world. He's here to talk about "the Avengers Initiative."

entries.title: The Incredible Hulk
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: June 13, 2008 · Phase 1 · Set in: 2010 (the same week as Iron Man 2 and Thor)
entries.story: Scientist Bruce Banner (played here by Edward Norton; Mark Ruffalo takes over the role from The Avengers onward) is hiding in Brazil after a gamma radiation experiment turned him into the Hulk, a rage-fuelled green giant. General Thaddeus "Thunderbolt" Ross wants to capture him and turn the Hulk into a weapon. Banner returns to the United States hoping for a cure and reunites with Betty Ross, the general's daughter and the woman he loves. Ross injects soldier Emil Blonsky with an early version of the super soldier serum and then Banner's blood, turning him into the monstrous Abomination, who tears through Harlem until the Hulk defeats him. Banner escapes and is last seen learning to control his transformations. General Ross and the Abomination both return years later (Captain America: Brave New World and She-Hulk), so this film matters more than people expect.
credits: Final scene (just before the credits): Tony Stark walks into a bar and tells a drunk General Ross that "we're putting a team together." There is no scene after the credits.
notes: (Distributed by Universal Pictures, which is why it was missing from Disney+ for years; it returned to Disney in 2023.)

entries.title: Iron Man 2
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Six months after revealing he is Iron Man, Tony is resisting the United States government's demand to hand over his suits, while the palladium in his arc reactor is slowly poisoning him. Ivan Vanko, a Russian physicist whose father was cheated by Tony's father Howard, attacks Tony at a Monaco race with electrified whips, and rival arms dealer Justin Hammer hires Vanko to build him an army of drone suits. Tony, believing he is dying, spirals and makes Pepper the chief executive of his company. Nick Fury and undercover agent Natasha Romanoff (Black Widow, in her first appearance) help him: a message hidden in Howard Stark's old Stark Expo model shows Tony how to build a new element that cures him. Tony and his best friend James "Rhodey" Rhodes (now War Machine) defeat Vanko's drones together at the Stark Expo.
credits: Post-credits: Agent Coulson arrives at a desert crater in New Mexico and reports that "we've found it." The camera reveals Thor's hammer, Mjolnir, in the crater. (The Incredible Hulk, Iron Man 2 and Thor all happen in roughly the same week.)

entries.title: Thor
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Thor, the arrogant heir to the throne of Asgard (a realm of god-like beings), defies his father Odin by attacking the Frost Giants of Jotunheim. Odin strips him of his powers and banishes him to Earth, sending his hammer Mjolnir after him with an enchantment that only someone "worthy" can lift it. In New Mexico, Thor is found by astrophysicist Jane Foster, her mentor Erik Selvig and her intern Darcy, while S.H.I.E.L.D. seizes the hammer. Back in Asgard, Thor's adopted brother Loki learns he is actually a Frost Giant, takes the throne while Odin sleeps, and sends the Destroyer armor to kill Thor. Thor sacrifices himself to protect the townspeople, which makes him worthy again; he regains his powers, returns to Asgard, and stops Loki, who falls into the void of space. The bridge between worlds (the Bifrost) is destroyed, cutting Thor off from Jane. Hawkeye (Clint Barton) makes a brief first appearance.
credits: Post-credits: Nick Fury shows Erik Selvig a glowing blue cube, the Tesseract, and asks him to study it. An invisible Loki is revealed to be controlling Selvig's mind. (The Tesseract holds the Space Stone, the first Infinity Stone shown in the films.)

entries.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: July 22, 2011 · Phase 1 · Set in: 1942 to 1945 (with a final scene in the present day)
entries.story: During World War II, Steve Rogers, a frail but brave young man from Brooklyn, is rejected by the army again and again until Dr. Abraham Erskine chooses him for a super soldier experiment that turns him into a peak human being. After being used as a costumed propaganda mascot, Steve becomes the real hero Captain America when he rescues captured soldiers, including his best friend Bucky Barnes. With Agent Peggy Carter, Colonel Chester Phillips, Howard Stark and his elite team the Howling Commandos, Steve battles HYDRA, a rogue Nazi science division led by Johann Schmidt, the Red Skull, who powers his weapons with the Tesseract. Bucky falls from a train and is presumed dead. Steve stops the Red Skull's bomber from destroying American cities by crashing it into the Arctic ice; the Red Skull vanishes when he touches the Tesseract. Steve wakes up nearly 70 years later in modern-day New York, where Nick Fury tells him he has been asleep for decades.
credits: Post-credits: Nick Fury asks Steve to join a mission to save the world, followed by a short teaser trailer for The Avengers.

entries.title: The Avengers
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Loki returns to Earth through the Tesseract, mind-controls Hawkeye and Erik Selvig with a glowing scepter, and steals the cube. He has struck a deal with a mysterious alien power: he will hand over the Tesseract in exchange for an alien army, the Chitauri, to conquer Earth. Nick Fury assembles Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Black Widow, the Hulk (now Mark Ruffalo) and Hawkeye, but the heroes clash with each other aboard S.H.I.E.L.D.'s flying Helicarrier until Loki kills Agent Coulson, which unites them. In the Battle of New York, the team fights the Chitauri invasion as Loki opens a portal in the sky over Manhattan; Tony flies a nuclear missile through the portal into space, destroying the alien mothership, and falls back to Earth just before the portal closes. Loki is captured and Thor takes him and the Tesseract back to Asgard. The near-death experience in space haunts Tony for years.
credits: Mid-credits: The Other, Loki's alien handler, reports to his master that attacking Earth means "to court death." The master turns and smiles: it is Thanos, in his first appearance.
Post-credits: The exhausted Avengers eat shawarma in silence in a wrecked restaurant.
notes: (Released as "Marvel Avengers Assemble" in the United Kingdom and Ireland.)

entries.title: Iron Man 3
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: May 3, 2013 · Phase 2 · Set in: Christmas, a few months after The Avengers (Marvel's 2023 official timeline places it in late 2013, after Thor: The Dark World)
entries.story: Suffering from panic attacks and insomnia after the Battle of New York, Tony builds dozens of Iron Man suits to cope. A terrorist called the Mandarin is bombing targets across the world, and when Tony publicly threatens him, his Malibu mansion is destroyed. Stranded in rural Tennessee with a damaged suit, Tony befriends a kid named Harley Keener and discovers the bombings are caused by Extremis, a treatment that makes people regenerate but can make them explode. The real villain is scientist Aldrich Killian, whom Tony snubbed years earlier, and the "Mandarin" is a hired actor named Trevor Slattery. Tony and Rhodey rescue the kidnapped President and Pepper (who has been injected with Extremis) in a battle at an oil rig, using every one of his remote suits. Tony has Pepper cured, gets the shrapnel removed from his chest, and destroys all his suits, declaring that he is still Iron Man without them.
credits: Post-credits: It turns out Tony has been telling this whole story to Bruce Banner, who fell asleep listening.

entries.title: Thor: The Dark World
entries.label: Story
entries.story: An ancient enemy, Malekith of the Dark Elves, awakens when the Nine Realms align, seeking a fluid-like weapon called the Aether to plunge the universe back into darkness. Jane Foster accidentally absorbs the Aether in London, and Thor brings her to Asgard to save her. The Dark Elves attack Asgard and kill Thor's mother, Frigga. Desperate, Thor frees the imprisoned Loki for help; Loki appears to die saving Thor in battle. In a chaotic final fight in Greenwich, London, where gateways between worlds open and close, Thor defeats Malekith. Thor turns down his father's throne to be with Jane. In the last shot, "Odin" on the throne is revealed to be Loki in disguise.
credits: Mid-credits: Sif and Volstagg give the Aether to the Collector (Taneleer Tivan), explaining it is unsafe to keep two Infinity Stones in Asgard. After they leave, the Collector says, "One down, five to go." (The Aether is the Reality Stone.)
Post-credits: Thor returns to Earth and kisses Jane. Meanwhile, a Frost Monster left behind from the battle is still running around London.

entries.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Steve Rogers works for S.H.I.E.L.D. in Washington D.C. but is uneasy about its plans to launch three new Helicarriers that can kill threats before they act. After Nick Fury is attacked and seemingly killed, Steve, Natasha and new ally Sam Wilson (the Falcon) discover that HYDRA has been secretly growing inside S.H.I.E.L.D. since World War II, led by senior official Alexander Pierce. HYDRA's top assassin, the Winter Soldier, turns out to be Bucky Barnes, brainwashed and kept frozen between missions for 70 years. The heroes reprogram the Helicarriers to destroy each other before HYDRA can use them, and Natasha dumps all of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets online, effectively ending the agency. Steve refuses to fight Bucky and is pulled from a river by him, a sign Bucky remembers something. Fury, who faked his death, goes underground.
credits: Mid-credits: HYDRA leader Baron Strucker studies Loki's scepter in a lab and holds two "miracles" captive: the twins Pietro and Wanda Maximoff (Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch), in their first appearance.
Post-credits: Bucky visits the Captain America exhibit at the Smithsonian museum and sees his own past.

entries.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Peter Quill, who was abducted from Earth as a boy in 1988 by a band of space pirates called the Ravagers, steals a mysterious orb on a distant planet. Every bounty hunter in the galaxy wants it, and he ends up in prison with green assassin Gamora (Thanos's adopted daughter), the genetically engineered raccoon Rocket, the tree-like Groot, and the vengeful warrior Drax. They escape together and learn the orb contains an Infinity Stone (the Power Stone) that the fanatical Kree warrior Ronan the Accuser plans to use, after betraying Thanos, to destroy the planet Xandar. The misfits become a team, and in the final battle Groot sacrifices himself to protect them, while Quill holds the Power Stone together with his friends' help to destroy Ronan. They give the stone to the Nova Corps for safe keeping, and a sprout of Groot is replanted as Baby Groot. Quill learns his father was "not from Earth."
credits: Mid-credits: Baby Groot dances in his pot to the Jackson 5, freezing whenever Drax looks at him.
Post-credits: In his destroyed museum, the Collector sits with Cosmo the space dog and is mocked by Howard the Duck.

entries.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
entries.label: Story
entries.story: The Avengers raid a HYDRA base and recover Loki's scepter, which Tony and Bruce discover holds an artificial intelligence. Haunted by a vision of his friends dying, Tony uses it to secretly build Ultron, a peacekeeping program meant to protect the world, but Ultron decides humanity must go extinct. Ultron recruits the Maximoff twins, whose powers came from the scepter: Wanda's mind tricks give each Avenger nightmares and send the Hulk on a rampage in Johannesburg, which Tony stops with his giant Hulkbuster armor. The team regroups at Hawkeye's secret family farm, and Ultron's plan to build a new body backfires when the Avengers take it, combining Tony's assistant program JARVIS with the gem from the scepter (the Mind Stone) to create Vision. Ultron lifts the city of Sokovia into the sky to crash it like a meteor; the team evacuates the city, Pietro dies saving Hawkeye, and Vision destroys Ultron's last body. Afterwards, the Hulk flies off alone into space, Thor leaves to investigate the Infinity Stones, and Captain America and Black Widow train a new team: War Machine, Falcon, Scarlet Witch and Vision.
credits: Mid-credits: Thanos opens a vault, puts on the golden Infinity Gauntlet, and says, "Fine. I'll do it myself."
Post-credits: None.

entries.title: Ant-Man
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Scott Lang, a good-hearted burglar just out of prison who wants to be a better father to his daughter Cassie, is recruited by scientist Hank Pym, the original Ant-Man from the 1960s to 1980s. Pym's former protégé Darren Cross has nearly recreated Pym's shrinking technology and plans to sell a weaponized version, the Yellowjacket suit, to HYDRA. Hank and his daughter Hope van Dyne train Scott to use the Ant-Man suit, which shrinks him to insect size while making him stronger, and to control ants. Scott briefly fights Falcon while stealing a part from the new Avengers base. During the heist, Scott shrinks to sub-atomic size to defeat Cross, enters the "Quantum Realm" where Hank's wife Janet was lost decades earlier, and manages to come back, giving Hank hope that Janet could still be alive.
credits: Mid-credits: Hank shows Hope a new prototype Wasp suit that was meant for her mother, and Hope says, "It's about damn time."

Post-credits: Steve and Sam have Bucky pinned in a hidden location and say they cannot call Tony because of "the Accords." Sam says he might "know a guy" (meaning Scott). This is a scene from Captain America: Civil War.

entries.title: Captain America: Civil War
entries.label: Story
entries.story: After a mission in Lagos goes wrong and civilians die, the world's governments demand the Avengers sign the Sokovia Accords, which would put them under United Nations control. Tony, guilt-ridden over Ultron, signs; Steve refuses. When a bombing at the United Nations is blamed on Bucky, Steve protects him, splitting the team into two sides that fight at a German airport: Tony's side includes Black Widow, War Machine, Vision, the newly introduced Black Panther (T'Challa, prince of Wakanda, whose father died in the bombing) and a teenage Spider-Man (Peter Parker, recruited by Tony); Steve's side includes Falcon, Bucky, Hawkeye, Scarlet Witch and Ant-Man. The real mastermind, Helmut Zemo, a Sokovian who lost his family in Ultron's attack, lures them to a Siberian HYDRA base and shows Tony footage proving a brainwashed Bucky killed Tony's parents in 1991. Tony attacks in fury, Steve and Bucky defeat him, and Steve leaves his shield behind. The Avengers are broken: Steve's team become fugitives, and Steve breaks his imprisoned friends out of the Raft prison.
credits: Mid-credits: In Wakanda, Bucky chooses to go back into frozen sleep until a cure for his brainwashing can be found, while T'Challa shelters him.
Post-credits: Peter Parker finds that his new web-shooters, a gift from Tony, project a red Spider-Man symbol. Text reads: "Spider-Man will return."

entries.title: Doctor Strange
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Stephen Strange, an arrogant and brilliant neurosurgeon, crushes his hands in a car crash and spends his fortune seeking a cure. In Kathmandu, Nepal, he finds the Ancient One, a sorcerer who teaches him the mystic arts, and her student Karl Mordo. Strange learns that the Eye of Agamotto, an amulet that controls time, holds an Infinity Stone (the Time Stone). Former student Kaecilius tries to bring Earth into the Dark Dimension, ruled by the demon Dormammu. After the Ancient One dies, Strange traps Dormammu in a time loop, dying over and over until Dormammu agrees to leave Earth in exchange for being released. Strange becomes the protector of the New York Sanctum, while Mordo, disgusted at how the rules of nature were bent, walks away.
credits: Mid-credits: Thor visits Strange in New York, looking for his father Odin, and Strange agrees to help find him if Thor takes Loki back to Asgard. (This scene plays out again in Thor: Ragnarok.)
Post-credits: Mordo steals the magic powers of Jonathan Pangborn and declares the world has "too many sorcerers."

entries.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: May 5, 2017 · Phase 3 · Set in: 2014 (a few months after the first film)
entries.story: After angering a golden-skinned race called the Sovereign (Rocket steals batteries from them), the Guardians are rescued by Ego, a being who reveals he is Peter Quill's father and a living planet. Gamora and her sister Nebula, who were both raised and tortured by Thanos, slowly repair their bond. Quill bonds with Ego until he learns his father planted seeds across the galaxy to take over every world and gave Quill's mother the brain tumor that killed her. Quill's former captor Yondu, of the Ravagers, helps the Guardians destroy Ego, and Quill loses his god-like powers. Yondu sacrifices himself to save Quill, who realizes Yondu was the father who really raised him. The Ravagers give Yondu a hero's funeral.
credits: Mid-credits 1: Kraglin practices using Yondu's whistle-controlled arrow and accidentally hits Drax.
Mid-credits 2: Ravager leader Stakar Ogord (Sylvester Stallone) reunites his old team.
Mid-credits 3: Sovereign leader Ayesha creates a new, more powerful being to destroy the Guardians and names him Adam (Adam Warlock, who finally appears in Vol. 3).
Mid-credits 4: A moody teenage Groot plays video games and talks back to Quill.
Post-credits: Stan Lee is stranded on a moon talking to the cosmic Watchers.

entries.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: July 7, 2017 · Phase 3 · Set in: fall 2016, a few months after Civil War (an on-screen "8 years later" caption is a known mistake)
entries.story: After his thrilling trip to the German airport fight, 15-year-old Peter Parker is back in Queens, New York, waiting for Tony Stark to call him up as an Avenger while fighting small-time crime in a suit Tony built for him. Adrian Toomes, a salvage worker put out of business by the clean-up of the Battle of New York, has become the Vulture, selling weapons made from alien technology. Peter tries to stop him alone, but a disastrous fight on the Staten Island Ferry leads Tony to take away the suit. Peter discovers that Toomes is the father of his date to the homecoming dance, Liz. Wearing his homemade suit, Peter defeats the Vulture and even saves his life. Peter turns down Tony's offer to join the Avengers, and Aunt May walks in just as he takes off his mask.
credits: Mid-credits: In prison, Toomes meets criminal Mac Gargan, who asks if he knows Spider-Man's identity. Toomes says no, protecting Peter. (Gargan finally becomes the Scorpion in Spider-Man: Brand New Day.)
Post-credits: A joke "patience" video starring Captain America that mocks waiting for post-credit scenes.
notes: (Co-produced by Sony Pictures and Marvel Studios.)

entries.title: Thor: Ragnarok
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Thor returns to Asgard, exposes Loki's impersonation of Odin, and, with Doctor Strange's help, finds their father in Norway, where Odin dies and frees his first-born daughter, Hela, the goddess of death. Hela destroys Mjolnir and takes over Asgard, while Thor is thrown onto the junk planet Sakaar, ruled by the eccentric Grandmaster. Thor is forced into gladiator fights and faces his champion, the Hulk, who has lived on Sakaar since Age of Ultron, and meets Valkyrie, a former Asgardian warrior. Thor, Loki, Hulk and Valkyrie escape, return to Asgard, and realize the only way to stop Hela is to let Surtur, a fire demon, destroy Asgard in "Ragnarok" (the end of Asgard). Thor, having lost an eye, becomes king and leads the surviving Asgardians onto a refugee ship bound for Earth.
credits: Mid-credits: Thor and Loki talk about whether going to Earth is wise, when a massive ship (Thanos's ship, the Sanctuary II) appears before them. (This leads directly into the opening of Avengers: Infinity War. Note: before leaving Asgard, Loki secretly took the Tesseract.)
Post-credits: The Grandmaster survives the uprising on Sakaar and declares the revolution "a tie."

entries.title: Black Panther
entries.label: Story
entries.story: T'Challa returns home to Wakanda, a secret, technologically advanced African nation built on a precious metal called vibranium, to be crowned king. With his sister Shuri, the general Okoye, and spy Nakia, he hunts arms dealer Ulysses Klaue in South Korea and meets CIA agent Everett Ross. American former soldier Erik "Killmonger" Stevens arrives, revealing he is T'Challa's cousin, abandoned in Oakland by T'Challa's father after that father killed Erik's father. Killmonger defeats T'Challa in ritual combat, takes the throne, and plans to send Wakandan weapons to oppressed people around the world. T'Challa survives, returns, and defeats Killmonger, who chooses death over imprisonment. Moved by what Killmonger stood for, T'Challa decides Wakanda will open itself to the world and share its knowledge.
credits: Mid-credits: T'Challa addresses the United Nations and announces that Wakanda will share its technology with the world.
Post-credits: Bucky Barnes wakes up in Wakanda, cured, and the local children call him "White Wolf."

entries.title: Avengers: Infinity War
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Thanos sets out to collect all six Infinity Stones so he can wipe out half of all life in the universe, which he believes will save it from overpopulation. He attacks the Asgardian refugee ship, kills Loki and Heimdall, beats the Hulk, and takes the Space Stone from the Tesseract (Banner crash lands on Earth to warn the heroes). The divided Avengers fight on several fronts: Tony, Doctor Strange and Spider-Man end up on Thanos's devastated home planet Titan with the Guardians; Thor, Rocket and Groot forge a new god-killing axe, Stormbreaker; and Steve's fugitive team protects Vision in Wakanda with Black Panther's army. Thanos sacrifices Gamora to get the Soul Stone, Strange gives up the Time Stone to save Tony's life, and Thanos takes the Mind Stone from Vision's head, killing him. (Thanos also took the Power Stone from Xandar off-screen and the Reality Stone from the Collector.) Thor strikes Thanos with Stormbreaker but does not "go for the head," and Thanos snaps his fingers. Half of all life turns to dust, including Spider-Man, Black Panther, Bucky, Doctor Strange, Scarlet Witch, Falcon and most of the Guardians, and Thanos retires to a quiet farm planet.
credits: Post-credits: As people turn to dust around him, Nick Fury sends an emergency signal on a pager just before he turns to dust himself. The pager shows the symbol of Captain Marvel. The credits end with "Thanos will return."

entries.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: July 6, 2018 · Phase 3 · Set in: 2018 (before and during the events of Infinity War)
entries.story: Scott Lang is days away from the end of two years of house arrest for helping Captain America in Civil War, when Hank Pym and Hope van Dyne (now the Wasp) recruit him because they believe Janet van Dyne is alive in the Quantum Realm and can be reached. They are chased by black-market dealer Sonny Burch and by Ghost (Ava Starr), a woman whose body is unstable after a lab accident and who wants to drain Janet's quantum energy to heal herself. Hank travels into the Quantum Realm and brings Janet back, and Janet uses her new quantum abilities to partly heal Ava. Scott makes it home just before his house arrest ends.
credits: Mid-credits: Scott goes into the Quantum Realm to collect healing particles for Ava. At that moment, Thanos's snap happens: Hank, Hope and Janet turn to dust, leaving Scott stranded in the Quantum Realm.
Post-credits: A giant ant plays the drums in Scott's empty house as an emergency broadcast plays on the television. Text reads: "Ant-Man and the Wasp will return?"

entries.title: Captain Marvel
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: March 8, 2019 · Phase 3 · Set in: 1995 (the earliest-set film after Captain America's war years)
entries.story: Vers is a member of an elite Kree military team with no memory of her past and the ability to shoot energy from her hands. While fighting the shape-shifting alien Skrulls, she crash-lands on Earth in 1995, where she teams up with a young Nick Fury (with both eyes) and a cat-like alien called Goose. She discovers she is actually Carol Danvers, a former United States Air Force pilot who gained her powers by absorbing the energy of a light-speed engine (powered by the Tesseract) designed by Kree scientist Mar-Vell. She also learns the Skrulls are refugees and that the Kree, led by her mentor Yon-Rogg and their ruler the Supreme Intelligence, have lied to her. Carol unlocks her full power, protects the Skrulls, led by Talos, and leaves to find them a new home, giving Fury a pager for emergencies. Fury names his planned superhero team the "Avengers" after Carol's old call sign, and Goose scratches out his eye.
credits: Mid-credits: In the present day (after Infinity War), Captain America, Black Widow, Bruce Banner and War Machine are monitoring Fury's pager when it turns off, and Carol appears behind them asking, "Where's Fury?"
Post-credits: Goose coughs up the Tesseract onto Fury's desk in 1995.

entries.title: Avengers: Endgame
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Twenty-three days after the snap, the surviving Avengers, with Captain Marvel, track Thanos down, but he has already destroyed the Stones; a furious Thor kills him. Five years pass. Scott Lang escapes the Quantum Realm by chance and suggests time travel through it, and Tony figures out how to make it work. The team splits up to "borrow" each Stone from the past: New York in 2012, Asgard in 2013, and the planets Morag and Vormir in 2014, where Natasha sacrifices herself to gain the Soul Stone. Bruce, now "Professor Hulk," uses a new gauntlet to snap everyone back to life, but a 2014 version of Thanos, who learned about the plan through Nebula's past self, follows them to the present and destroys the Avengers base. All the returned heroes arrive through portals for an enormous final battle, and Tony takes the Stones and snaps Thanos and his army out of existence, dying from the strain. After Tony's funeral, Steve returns the Stones to their original times, but chooses to stay in the past to live a life with Peggy Carter, reappearing as an old man to give his shield to Sam Wilson. (During the 2012 heist, a 2012 version of Loki escapes with the Tesseract, creating a new timeline that leads to the Loki show.)
credits: No mid- or post-credits scenes. After the credits there is only the sound of metal being hammered, a nod to Tony building his first suit in Iron Man.
Encore re-release (2026): adds a changed ending and new scenes after the credits that lead into Avengers: Doomsday. They are not summarized here.
notes: Back in cinemas: Avengers: Endgame Encore opened on September 25, 2026 with about four minutes of new footage. On October 4, 2026 it carried Endgame past Avatar to become the highest-grossing film of all time, at about $2.93 billion.

entries.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: July 2, 2019 · Phase 3 (the epilogue of the Infinity Saga) · Set in: summer 2024 (about eight months after everyone returned in Endgame)
entries.story: The world is recovering from "the Blip," the five years when half of life was gone, and Peter, mourning Tony, wants a normal school trip to Europe so he can tell MJ he likes her. Nick Fury recruits him to help Quentin Beck, a hero called Mysterio who claims to be from another Earth and fights giant elemental monsters. Tony leaves Peter his EDITH glasses, which control a huge network of Stark drones, and Peter hands them to Beck. Beck is a fraud: a former Stark Industries employee who uses drone-created illusions to stage the monster attacks and become the world's next great hero. Peter outwits Beck in London, recovers EDITH, and Beck dies in the final fight. Peter and MJ start dating.
credits: Mid-credits: The tabloid news host J. Jonah Jameson (J.K. Simmons, returning from the 2002 to 2007 films) broadcasts a doctored video by Beck framing Spider-Man for the attacks and revealing Peter Parker's identity to the world.
Post-credits: The "Nick Fury" and "Maria Hill" in this film were really the Skrulls Talos and Soren in disguise. The real Fury is relaxing on a Skrull spaceship in space.
notes: (Co-produced by Sony Pictures and Marvel Studios.)

entries.title: Black Widow
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: July 9, 2021 · Phase 4 · Set in: 2016 (between Captain America: Civil War and Avengers: Infinity War)
entries.story: On the run after Civil War, Natasha Romanoff receives a package from Yelena Belova, the woman she grew up with as a "sister" when both were children planted in Ohio by Russian spies. Natasha learns that the Red Room, the program that kidnapped and brainwashed girls into assassins called Widows, is still running, and that its leader Dreykov, whom she thought she had killed, is alive and controlling the Widows with a mind-control chemical. Natasha and Yelena break their fake "father," the washed-up Russian super soldier Alexei (Red Guardian), out of prison and reunite with their fake "mother" Melina, a Red Room scientist. They find the Red Room hidden in a flying sky base and face Taskmaster, who copies fighting styles and turns out to be Dreykov's daughter Antonia, whom Natasha nearly killed years ago. Natasha frees the Widows from mind control, the base falls from the sky, and Dreykov dies. Natasha goes back on the run, where she will reunite with Steve Rogers before Infinity War.
credits: Post-credits: After Endgame, Yelena visits Natasha's grave and meets Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, a shadowy power broker who tells her that the man responsible for Natasha's death is Clint Barton (Hawkeye). (This leads directly into the Hawkeye show.)

entries.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Shaun, a parking valet in San Francisco, is attacked on a bus by assassins and reveals to his best friend Katy that he is really Shang-Chi, son of Wenwu, a centuries-old warlord who wears ten mystical rings that give him immortality and power. Wenwu, leader of the real Ten Rings organization (the group behind Tony's kidnapping in Iron Man), believes he can hear his dead wife Ying Li calling to him from behind a sealed gate in her hidden village, Ta Lo. Shang-Chi, Katy and his estranged sister Xialing race to Ta Lo, where they learn the voice is a trick by the Dweller-in-Darkness, a soul-eating monster that wants to escape. In the battle at the gate, Shang-Chi defeats his father, but Wenwu dies saving his son from the Dweller and passes the rings to him, and Shang-Chi and Katy destroy the monster with help from a great dragon. (Trevor Slattery, the fake Mandarin from Iron Man 3, returns as comic relief.)
credits: Mid-credits: Wong brings Shang-Chi and Katy to meet Captain Marvel and Bruce Banner by hologram. They examine the ten rings and discover they are sending a signal to somewhere unknown.
Post-credits: Xialing takes over the Ten Rings organization and starts training women warriors.

entries.title: Eternals
entries.label: Story
entries.story: The Eternals are ten immortal, superpowered beings sent to Earth 7,000 years ago by Arishem, one of the giant, ancient cosmic beings called Celestials, to protect humans from monstrous predators called Deviants; they were forbidden from stepping in on any other human conflict, including Thanos. After the Blip, the Deviants return and the Eternals' leader Ajak is killed, so Sersi gathers the scattered team. Sersi learns the truth: the Eternals are robots, and their real mission is to let a Celestial named Tiamut be "born" from inside the Earth, which will destroy the planet, and the population boom after the Blip has triggered this "Emergence." Ikaris, the strongest Eternal, reveals he killed Ajak to protect the mission. The team splits; Sersi, using the combined power of her allies, turns Tiamut to stone, and Ikaris flies into the sun out of guilt. Arishem arrives, takes Sersi, Kingo and Phastos away to judge them, and promises to return.
credits: Mid-credits: Thena, Druig and Makkari, flying on their spaceship to find other Eternals, meet Eros (Thanos's brother, played by Harry Styles) and his sidekick Pip the Troll.

Post-credits: Dane Whitman, Sersi's boyfriend, opens a box holding a cursed sword (the Ebony Blade). An off-screen voice, that of the vampire hunter Blade (Mahershala Ali), asks, "You sure you're ready for that, Mr. Whitman?"

entries.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
entries.label: Story
entries.story: The world now knows Peter is Spider-Man, he is blamed for Mysterio's death, and he, MJ and Ned are rejected by every college. Peter asks Doctor Strange to cast a spell that will make everyone forget he is Spider-Man, but Peter keeps changing the request during the spell, and it breaks: people from other universes who know Spider-Man's identity are pulled in, including the villains Doctor Octopus, Green Goblin, Electro, Sandman and the Lizard from the earlier Sony films. Instead of sending them home to die, Peter tries to cure them; the Green Goblin turns on him and kills Aunt May, who leaves Peter with the words "with great power, there must also come great responsibility." MJ and Ned use Strange's magic to bring in two other Peter Parkers, played by Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield, who help the heartbroken Peter. The three Spider-Men cure the villains at the Statue of Liberty, but the spell starts cracking open the multiverse, so Peter asks Strange to make everyone in the world forget Peter Parker ever existed. MJ and Ned no longer know him, and Peter, now completely alone, makes a homemade suit and swings off into the snowy night.
credits: Mid-credits: Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy), pulled into this universe at a bar in Mexico, learns about the Avengers and the Blip, then is pulled back to his own world by Strange's spell, but leaves behind a small piece of the Venom symbiote.
Post-credits: In theaters, a teaser trailer for Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. (The later extended release has a different blooper reel.)
notes: (Co-produced by Sony Pictures and Marvel Studios.)

entries.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
entries.label: Story
entries.story: America Chavez, a teenager who can punch star-shaped portals between universes but cannot control it, crashes into Strange's world while fleeing a demon. Strange asks Wanda Maximoff for help and learns she is the one hunting America: corrupted by the evil Book of the Damned, the Darkhold, after WandaVision, Wanda wants America's power so she can reach a universe where her children Billy and Tommy are real. Strange and America escape to Earth-838, where they are arrested by the Illuminati, a council of that universe's heroes (Professor X, Captain Carter, Black Bolt, Maria Rambeau as Captain Marvel, Reed Richards of the Fantastic Four, and Baron Mordo). Wanda, possessing her alternate self, slaughters the Illuminati, kidnaps America and starts taking her power. Strange uses the Darkhold to possess the corpse of another dead version of himself and fights back; America learns to control her power and sends Wanda to the 838 universe, where Wanda sees her sons there afraid of her. Wanda comes to her senses, destroys every copy of the Darkhold along with herself, and Strange, having used dark magic, sprouts a third eye in his forehead. (The last credits scene of VisionQuest later shows that Wanda survived.)
credits: Mid-credits: Clea, a sorceress from the Dark Dimension (Charlize Theron), tells Strange his meddling caused an "incursion" (two universes colliding) and he must help fix it. Strange opens his third eye and follows her.
Post-credits: Pizza Poppa (Bruce Campbell), a street vendor Strange cursed earlier, is finally freed from the spell.

entries.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Thor, travelling with the Guardians after Endgame, learns that Gorr, an alien whose god let his daughter die, has picked up the god-killing Necrosword and is murdering gods across the universe. Gorr attacks New Asgard on Earth and kidnaps its children. There Thor meets Jane Foster, his ex-girlfriend, who has stage four cancer and is now wielding a rebuilt Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor, though the hammer drains her strength as it heals her. Thor, Jane, King Valkyrie and Korg try to recruit the gods of Omnipotence City and their leader Zeus, who refuses to help; Thor steals Zeus's lightning bolt. Gorr is after Eternity, a being at the center of the universe that grants one wish. Thor and Jane defeat Gorr together, and Jane dies in Thor's arms; Gorr uses his wish to bring his daughter Love back instead of destroying the gods, and asks Thor to raise her.
credits: Mid-credits: Zeus, who survived, tells his son Hercules (Brett Goldstein) that the gods are now mocked because of Thor, and orders him to kill Thor.
Post-credits: Jane arrives in Valhalla, the afterlife for warriors, and is welcomed by Heimdall.

entries.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
entries.label: Story
entries.story: King T'Challa dies of an illness Shuri could not cure (the film honours the late actor Chadwick Boseman), and Queen Ramonda leads Wakanda while the rest of the world tries to steal vibranium. When the Central Intelligence Agency finds vibranium at the bottom of the Atlantic Ocean using a machine built by brilliant student Riri Williams, they are attacked by Namor, the winged-ankled king of the underwater Mayan-inspired kingdom Talokan, which also has vibranium. Namor demands Wakanda hand over the inventor or he will attack, and Shuri and Okoye rescue Riri, which causes a war; Talokan floods Wakanda, and Ramonda dies saving Riri. Shuri recreates the heart-shaped herb that gives the Black Panther its powers and becomes the new Black Panther. She defeats Namor but spares his life, forming an alliance to protect both nations.
credits: Mid-credits: In Haiti, Nakia introduces Shuri to her son: Toussaint, the young son of T'Challa, whose Wakandan name is also T'Challa.
Post-credits: None.

entries.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Scott Lang is enjoying fame as an Avenger, but his teenage daughter Cassie has been building a device to map the Quantum Realm, and when she switches it on, Scott, Cassie, Hope, Hank and Janet are all sucked into it. There they discover a hidden civilization, and Janet finally reveals what she kept secret for 30 years: she helped a stranded traveler, Kang the Conqueror, before learning he was a murderous variant of the man who controls time, and she sabotaged his power core to trap him there. Kang forces Scott to steal the core back for him, using Cassie as a hostage, and Darren Cross from Ant-Man returns as the deformed M.O.D.O.K. The Quantum Realm's freedom fighters, Cassie, Hank's army of ants, and the family band together, and Scott and Hope seem to defeat Kang by dropping him into his own power core. Back home, Scott wonders whether Kang's warning that "the Conqueror" was only the beginning was true.
credits: Mid-credits: In an arena outside of time, thousands of Kang variants (including Immortus, Rama-Tut and Centurion) gather as the Council of Kangs, plotting to invade the multiverse.
Post-credits: In the early 1900s, Loki and Mobius of the Time Variance Authority watch inventor Victor Timely, another Kang variant, give a presentation. (This leads into season 2 of Loki.)
notes: Note on Kang: Marvel originally built Phases 5 and 6 toward a film called Avengers: The Kang Dynasty. In December 2023, Marvel parted ways with actor Jonathan Majors, and the film became Avengers: Doomsday, with Doctor Doom as the main villain. Kang's story ends with Loki season 2 and has not continued.

entries.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
entries.label: Story
entries.story: The Guardians have rebuilt Knowhere as their home base, but Peter Quill is drinking heavily over the loss of Gamora (the version from 2014 who came forward in Endgame does not remember him and has joined the Ravagers). The golden super-being Adam Warlock attacks and badly wounds Rocket, and a "kill switch" implanted in Rocket's body stops the team from healing him. To save Rocket, the Guardians infiltrate the company that made him, run by the High Evolutionary, a scientist obsessed with creating a "perfect" society by experimenting on animals. While Rocket is unconscious, flashbacks reveal his traumatic origin and his lost friends Lylla, Teefs and Floor. The team storms the High Evolutionary's ship, Rocket wakes up and confronts his creator, and they rescue the captured children and animals, while Adam Warlock saves Quill's life in space. In the end, the team breaks up: Quill goes to Earth to see his grandfather, Gamora returns to the Ravagers, Mantis goes off to find herself, and Rocket becomes the leader of a new Guardians.
credits: Mid-credits: The new Guardians (Rocket, Groot, Kraglin, Cosmo, Adam Warlock and a rescued girl named Phyla) fight a monster while saving a village.
Post-credits: Peter Quill eats breakfast with his grandfather on Earth. Text reads: "The Legendary Star-Lord will return."

entries.title: The Marvels
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Captain Marvel (Carol Danvers), Monica Rambeau (now able to see and absorb energy, after WandaVision) and teenage superfan Kamala Khan (Ms. Marvel) discover they swap places with each other whenever they use their light-based powers at the same time. The cause is Dar-Benn, a Kree leader who found one of the Quantum Bands (the twin of the bangle Kamala wears) and is tearing holes through space to steal resources for the Kree homeworld Hala, which Carol left ruined when she destroyed the Supreme Intelligence long ago. Forced to work together, the three heroes, aided by Nick Fury and a ship full of cat-like aliens called Flerken, learn to time their swaps and fight Dar-Benn. Dar-Benn's actions rip a hole in reality that threatens two universes; Monica seals it, but is trapped on the other side. Back on Earth, Kamala visits Kate Bishop (from the Hawkeye show) to recruit her for a new young team, mentioning Cassie Lang.
credits: Mid-credits: Monica wakes up in another universe, cared for by her mother Maria Rambeau, who in this world is the hero Binary, and by Hank McCoy, known as Beast of the X-Men (Kelsey Grammer, reprising his role from the Fox X-Men films). This is the first direct link between the main story and the old Fox X-Men films, and it pays off in Avengers: Doomsday.

entries.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: July 26, 2024 · Phase 5 · Set in: Deadpool's own universe (Earth-10005, the world of the Fox X-Men films) and the Void, around 2024
entries.story: Wade Wilson, the foul-mouthed, unkillable mercenary Deadpool, has retired from heroics after being turned down by the Avengers, when the Time Variance Authority (the bureaucracy that polices the timeline) abducts him. Agent Paradox tells Wade his entire universe is dying early because its "anchor being," Wolverine, died in Logan, and offers Wade a place in the main universe. Wade refuses and tracks down a replacement: the "worst" Wolverine in the multiverse, a drunk, guilt-ridden variant who failed his own X-Men. Paradox banishes both to the Void, a wasteland at the end of time ruled by Cassandra Nova, Charles Xavier's psychic twin sister. There they meet heroes from forgotten Fox films: Elektra, Blade (Wesley Snipes), Laura (X-23) and Gambit, plus Johnny Storm, the Human Torch, played by Chris Evans, whom Cassandra kills. Deadpool and Wolverine stop Paradox's machine (the Time Ripper) from destroying their universe, Cassandra dies, and this Wolverine stays in Wade's world as part of his chosen family.
credits: During the credits: A montage of behind-the-scenes footage from 20 years of Fox Marvel films, as a farewell to that era.
Post-credits: Johnny Storm, back in the Void, delivers in full the crude insult that Wade earlier quoted him as saying to Cassandra Nova.
notes: (The first Deadpool film made by Marvel Studios. It also works as the finale of the Fox X-Men series: see Part 3.)

entries.title: Captain America: Brave New World
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Sam Wilson is now Captain America (after the Falcon and the Winter Soldier show), with Joaquin Torres as the new Falcon. Thaddeus Ross, the general from The Incredible Hulk, is now President of the United States (played by Harrison Ford) and is pushing a global treaty to share adamantium, a nearly indestructible metal found on Celestial Island, the giant stone body left in the Indian Ocean at the end of Eternals. At a White House summit, several people, including the original black Captain America Isaiah Bradley, are triggered by a song and try to assassinate Ross. Sam uncovers the mastermind: Samuel Sterns, the Leader, a scientist mutated by Bruce Banner's blood back in The Incredible Hulk, who has been secretly drugging Ross. At a press event, Ross transforms into the giant Red Hulk and rampages through Washington D.C. until Sam calms him by reminding him of his daughter Betty. Isaiah is freed, the treaty is signed, Ross resigns and goes to prison, and Sam plans to rebuild the Avengers.
credits: Post-credits: Sam visits Sterns in the Raft prison, and Sterns warns him that "other worlds" (other universes) are coming, and that the Avengers will be needed to face them.

entries.title: Thunderbolts*
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: May 2, 2025 · Phase 5 (the final film of Phase 5) · Set in: around 2027
entries.story: Yelena Belova, grieving Natasha and working as a hired killer for Valentina Allegra de Fontaine (now director of the Central Intelligence Agency), is sent to a secret vault, where she finds the other operatives Valentina has also sent to kill each other: John Walker (the disgraced former Captain America from The Falcon and the Winter Soldier), Ghost (from Ant-Man and the Wasp) and Taskmaster, who is killed. They also find Bob, a confused man who survived Valentina's experiment, "the Sentry Project," to create a super-powered protector. With the help of Yelena's father Alexei and Congressman Bucky Barnes, the misfits escape and turn on Valentina. Bob becomes the god-like Sentry, but his dark side, the Void, takes over, covers New York in shadow and traps people inside their worst memories. Yelena and the team reach Bob inside his own darkness and save him with compassion rather than violence. To protect herself, Valentina announces the team publicly as "the New Avengers," and Yelena tells her they now have power over her.
credits: Mid-credits: Alexei tries to sell a cereal box with the New Avengers' faces on it to an uninterested shopper.

Post-credits: 14 months later, the New Avengers argue in their tower about Sam Wilson suing them over the name "Avengers." An alien alarm goes off: a spaceship marked with a "4" (the Fantastic Four's ship, coming from another universe) is entering Earth's atmosphere.
notes: (After release, Marvel added "The New Avengers" to the title in marketing and the credits; the asterisk was the joke. The film is still listed as Thunderbolts*.)

entries.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: July 25, 2025 · Phase 6 (the first film of Phase 6) · Set in: a different universe, Earth-828, in a retro-futuristic version of 1964
entries.story: On Earth-828, a world styled like the 1960s imagined the future, the Fantastic Four have been heroes for four years, ever since a cosmic ray accident gave them powers: Reed Richards (Mister Fantastic, who can stretch), his wife Sue Storm (the Invisible Woman, who can turn invisible and create force fields), her brother Johnny Storm (the Human Torch, who can burst into flame and fly) and Ben Grimm (the Thing, made of orange rock). Sue is pregnant when a silver herald named Shalla-Bal, the Silver Surfer, arrives to announce that her master Galactus, a giant being who eats planets, will devour Earth. The family flies into space to plead with Galactus, who offers to spare Earth in exchange for their unborn son, whose cosmic power he wants; Sue gives birth to Franklin during a desperate escape. The public turns against the family for refusing the deal, and Reed's plan to teleport Earth away fails, so they use Franklin as bait to lure Galactus into a portal. Shalla-Bal turns against her master and sacrifices herself to push Galactus through, Sue dies saving her son and baby Franklin brings her back to life, showing his power. (The Fantastic Four later travel into the main universe, as seen in the Thunderbolts* post-credits scene.)
credits: Mid-credits: Four years later, Sue finds young Franklin sitting with a hooded stranger who holds a metal mask: Doctor Doom (played by Robert Downey Jr., face unseen). This leads into Avengers: Doomsday.
Post-credits: The family's robot H.E.R.B.I.E. switches off an old in-universe cartoon about the Fantastic Four.
notes: (Not set in the main Marvel Cinematic Universe. See Part 4 for every Fantastic Four film.)

entries.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
entries.label: Story
meta: Released: July 31, 2026 · Phase 6 · Set in: about four years after No Way Home, shortly before Avengers: Doomsday
entries.story: Nobody remembers Peter Parker, and he now protects New York alone and anonymously, defeating criminal Mac Gargan (who becomes the armored Scorpion) and the ninja clan the Hand, and earning the trust of police detective Jean DeWolff. A mysterious telepath who can jump from body to body is attacking the Department of Damage Control (the government agency that cleans up after superhero battles) looking for something called "V-Max," and the trail brings Peter into contact with Yelena Belova and Frank Castle, the Punisher. Meanwhile, Peter's powers are changing: he grows organic webs from his wrists and starts losing control, and Bruce Banner helps him build a device to suppress them. The telepath turns out to be Jean Grey, a young mutant searching for her sister Sara, whom Damage Control boss Bill Metzger held captive; Jean possesses Banner and unleashes the uncontrollable Savage Hulk, whom Peter calms down. At a Damage Control site on Roosevelt Island, Jean learns her sister died there and freezes everyone around her with a psychic field; Peter removes his suppressor, defeats the Hand and reaches Jean through her mind, then takes a bullet from the Punisher meant for her, and Jean keeps him alive. Jean leaves the city, Damage Control is investigated, and Peter resolves to stop doing everything alone, reintroducing himself to Ned with their old handshake.
credits: Mid-credits: None.

Post-credits: Ned's "Spidey Tracker" app shows a Spider-Man sighting, then glitches as its map zooms away from Earth and pinpoints Spider-Man somewhere in outer space. Text reads: "Spider-Man will return." (What this means has not been revealed.)
notes: (Co-produced by Sony Pictures and Marvel Studios.)

entries.title: Avengers: Doomsday
entries.label: What is known
meta: Release date: December 18, 2026 (tickets are on sale) · Phase 6 · Set in: about 14 months after Thunderbolts*
entries.story: Directed by Joe and Anthony Russo (who made Civil War, Infinity War and Endgame), this is the fifth Avengers film. Robert Downey Jr., who played Tony Stark, returns as the villain Victor von Doom (Doctor Doom). Heroes from three universes unite against him: the Avengers, the Wakandans and the New Avengers from the main universe; the Fantastic Four from Earth-828; and the original X-Men from the Fox films (Patrick Stewart as Professor X, Ian McKellen as Magneto, James Marsden as Cyclops, Alan Cumming as Nightcrawler, Rebecca Romijn as Mystique, Kelsey Grammer as Beast), plus Channing Tatum's Gambit. Chris Evans returns as Steve Rogers, alongside Chris Hemsworth (Thor), Anthony Mackie (Captain America), Sebastian Stan (Bucky), Letitia Wright (Shuri), Paul Rudd (Ant-Man), Simu Liu (Shang-Chi), Tom Hiddleston (Loki) and many others. Elizabeth Olsen's Wanda Maximoff is set to return too: the last credits scene of VisionQuest shows Doom waking her. Trailers suggest universes are colliding (the "incursions" first described in Multiverse of Madness). The full story and any credit scenes are unknown until release.
notes: What to watch before Doomsday: at minimum Avengers: Endgame, WandaVision, Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, Loki (both seasons), Captain America: Brave New World, Thunderbolts*, The Fantastic Four: First Steps, VisionQuest, and the Fox X-Men films. The "Ready for Doomsday" route near the top of this page turns that into a checklist.

entries.title: Avengers: Secret Wars
entries.label: What is known
meta: Release date: December 17, 2027 · Phase 6 (the final film of the Multiverse Saga)
entries.story: The sequel to Doomsday and the conclusion of the Multiverse Saga, again directed by the Russo brothers. In the comics, "Secret Wars" is the story where the multiverse collapses and Doctor Doom rebuilds the surviving fragments into a single patchwork world called Battleworld. The plot, cast and credit scenes have not been announced.

entries.title: Spider-Man
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Shy high school senior Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically altered spider on a school trip and gains spider powers, including the ability to shoot webs naturally from his wrists. He uses his powers to win money in a wrestling match and lets a robber escape out of spite; the same robber later kills his beloved Uncle Ben, teaching Peter that "with great power comes great responsibility." Meanwhile, Norman Osborn, the father of Peter's best friend Harry, tests an unstable performance-enhancing formula on himself and becomes the insane Green Goblin. The Goblin learns Spider-Man's identity and threatens Mary Jane Watson, the girl next door Peter has loved for years, and Aunt May. In the final fight, Norman tries to impale Spider-Man with his glider but is killed by it instead; Harry blames Spider-Man for his father's death. Peter tells Mary Jane they can only be friends, to protect her.
credits: None.

entries.title: Spider-Man 2
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Two years later, Peter is exhausted from juggling college, jobs and crime-fighting, and his powers start to fail as he doubts himself. His scientific hero Otto Octavius loses his wife in a failed fusion experiment and is fused to four mechanical arms whose built-in artificial intelligence pushes him to rebuild the reactor, becoming Doctor Octopus. Peter gives up being Spider-Man for a while, but returns when he sees the city needs him. In a famous fight on an elevated train, Spider-Man stops the runaway train with his body, and the passengers see his face and protect him. Doctor Octopus delivers Spider-Man to Harry, who unmasks him; Peter convinces Otto to drown his reactor, and Otto dies doing so. Mary Jane learns Peter's secret and leaves her own wedding to be with him, while Harry finds his father's hidden Green Goblin lair.
credits: None.

entries.title: Spider-Man 3
entries.label: Story
entries.story: An alien goo, the black symbiote, arrives on a meteorite and bonds with Peter, giving him a black suit that makes him stronger but also more aggressive and arrogant. Escaped convict Flint Marko falls into a particle experiment and becomes the Sandman; Peter learns Marko was the real killer of Uncle Ben. Harry, now the New Goblin, attacks Peter, loses his memory, then recovers it and manipulates Mary Jane into breaking up with Peter. Peter rips off the symbiote in a church bell tower, and it falls onto rival photographer Eddie Brock, creating Venom. Harry and Peter team up to fight Venom and Sandman; Harry dies saving Peter, Eddie Brock dies along with the symbiote when Peter destroys it, and Peter forgives Sandman.
credits: None.

entries.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
entries.label: Story
entries.story: A reboot. Peter Parker, abandoned as a child by his scientist parents and raised by Uncle Ben and Aunt May, finds his father's old research and visits Oscorp, where he is bitten by a genetically engineered spider. After Uncle Ben is killed by a thief Peter let escape, Peter hunts for the killer as Spider-Man, building his own mechanical web-shooters. His father's former partner, Dr. Curt Connors, injects himself with a lizard formula to regrow his missing arm and becomes the Lizard, who plans to turn all of New York into reptiles. Peter falls for classmate Gwen Stacy, whose father, Police Captain George Stacy, dies helping stop the Lizard, and makes Peter promise to keep Gwen out of danger. Peter at first breaks off the relationship, then hints that he may not keep that promise.
credits: Mid-credits: In his prison cell, Connors is visited by a man in shadow who asks whether he told Peter the truth about his father. Connors says no and tells him to leave Peter alone. (The man was later revealed as Gustav Fiers, but the planned sequels that would have explained him were cancelled.)

entries.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Peter is happily dating Gwen despite his promise to her late father. His childhood friend Harry Osborn returns to run Oscorp and learns he is dying of the same genetic disease that killed his father Norman, and believes Spider-Man's blood can save him. Max Dillon, a lonely Oscorp electrician who idolizes Spider-Man, falls into a tank of electric eels and becomes Electro. Peter learns his father fled because he refused to let Oscorp misuse his spider research. Harry injects himself with spider venom, becomes the Green Goblin, and frees Electro; Spider-Man defeats Electro at a power plant, but in the clock tower fight with the Goblin, Gwen falls and her neck snaps as Peter's web catches her, killing her. Months later, a grieving Peter returns to face a new villain, the Rhino, after watching Gwen's graduation speech about hope. Meanwhile, the shadowy Gustav Fiers visits the imprisoned Harry to start assembling a villain team, hinting at the Sinister Six.
credits: Mid-credits: A clip from X-Men: Days of Future Past (a cross-promotion; it has no story connection to Spider-Man).
notes: Sony's planned sequels and a "Sinister Six" film were cancelled after this film, which led to the deal with Marvel Studios and Tom Holland's version. Garfield's Peter finally got a happier ending in No Way Home, where he saves MJ from a fall the way he failed to save Gwen.

entries.title: Captain America: Civil War
entries.label: Peter's story
entries.story: Tony Stark visits 15-year-old Peter Parker in his Queens apartment, reveals he knows Peter is the masked "Spider-Man" from online videos, and recruits him for his side of the Avengers' split. At the German airport battle, Peter grabs Captain America's shield, webs up Bucky and Falcon, and helps bring down Ant-Man in his giant form. Tony sends him home with a new high-tech suit, telling him to stay a "friendly neighborhood Spider-Man" for now. Credit scenes: the post-credits scene shows Peter discovering his new web-shooter projects a red Spider-Man symbol.

entries.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
entries.tag: Peter wants to be an Avenger
entries.label: Peter's story
entries.story: Peter is desperate to prove himself to Tony, who keeps him at arm's length through his bodyguard Happy Hogan. He takes on the Vulture, Adrian Toomes, without permission, nearly sinks the Staten Island Ferry and loses his Stark suit, learning that he has to be a hero without the gadgets ("If you're nothing without the suit, then you shouldn't have it"). He stops Toomes in his homemade suit and turns down a place in the Avengers. He gains a best friend and confidant, Ned, and a future love interest, Michelle, who goes by "MJ." Credit scenes: in prison, Toomes hides Peter's identity from Mac Gargan (mid-credits); a Captain America "patience" video (post-credits).

entries.title: Avengers: Infinity War and Avengers: Endgame
entries.label: Peter's story
meta: Released: April 27, 2018 and April 26, 2019 · see entries #19 and #22
entries.story: Peter jumps off his school bus to help Tony fight Thanos's henchman Ebony Maw, is given the Iron Spider armor, and is "knighted" as an Avenger on the planet Titan. When Thanos snaps, Peter turns to dust in Tony's arms ("I don't feel so good"). Five years later, he returns through a portal for the final battle, carries the Infinity Gauntlet across the battlefield, and is beside Tony when he dies. Credit scenes: Infinity War ends with Nick Fury paging Captain Marvel; Endgame has none.

entries.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
entries.label: Peter's story
entries.story: Grieving his mentor and pressured by a world asking who the next Iron Man will be, Peter just wants a school trip to Europe with MJ. He hands Tony's powerful EDITH glasses to Mysterio, believing him a worthy hero, and learns too late that Mysterio is a fraud. He takes responsibility, defeats Mysterio, and starts dating MJ. Credit scenes: J. Jonah Jameson reveals Peter's identity to the world (mid-credits); Nick Fury and Maria Hill were Skrulls in disguise (post-credits).

entries.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
entries.label: Peter's story
entries.story: Unmasked and hounded, Peter asks Doctor Strange to make the world forget, which pulls villains (and two other Spider-Men) in from other universes. Instead of sending the villains home to die, Peter chooses to cure them, and pays for it when the Green Goblin kills Aunt May. With help from the other two Peter Parkers, who share their own losses (Uncle Ben and Gwen Stacy), he cures the villains and sacrifices his own identity to save the multiverse: nobody, including MJ and Ned, remembers him anymore. This is the moment he truly becomes the Spider-Man of the comics: alone, broke, and still doing the right thing. Credit scenes: Eddie Brock leaves a piece of the Venom symbiote behind (mid-credits); a teaser for Multiverse of Madness (post-credits).

entries.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
entries.label: Peter's story
entries.story: Four years after being forgotten, Peter is a full-time street-level hero with no mentor, no friends and no help, which makes him more isolated and more reckless. His powers begin mutating, a sign there is more to his spider bite than he knew, and he needs Bruce Banner's help to keep them in check. Caught between the Punisher's brutal methods and a grieving mutant, Jean Grey, he chooses mercy and nearly dies for it. He ends the film deciding he no longer has to carry everything by himself, and reconnects with Ned (MJ still does not remember him). Credit scenes: no mid-credits scene; the post-credits scene shows Ned's Spidey Tracker app finding Spider-Man somewhere in deep space.

entries.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is bitten by a radioactive spider and then watches his world's Spider-Man, Peter Parker, die trying to stop the crime boss Kingpin, whose particle collider is tearing holes between universes. The collider pulls in Spider-People from other worlds: a tired, older Peter B. Parker, Gwen Stacy (Spider-Woman), Spider-Man Noir, Peni Parker with her robot, and Spider-Ham. Miles discovers his beloved Uncle Aaron is the villain Prowler, who is killed by Kingpin after refusing to kill Miles. Miles takes his "leap of faith," masters his powers, sends the others home and destroys the collider. He becomes his world's new Spider-Man.
credits: Post-credits: Miguel O'Hara, Spider-Man 2099 (Oscar Isaac), gets his multiverse-travel watch working and visits the world of the 1967 Spider-Man cartoon, recreating the famous "pointing Spider-Men" meme. A tribute to Spider-Man's creators Stan Lee and Steve Ditko also plays.

entries.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
entries.label: Story
entries.story: A year later, Miles's minor villain the Spot, who can open holes between universes, grows dangerously powerful. Gwen, now a member of Miguel O'Hara's Spider-Society (an organization of Spider-People from across the multiverse), visits Miles, and Miles follows her into other worlds. Miguel reveals "canon events," tragic moments every Spider-Person must live through to keep their universe stable, such as the death of a police captain close to them, and Miles learns his own father is about to die. Refusing to accept that, Miles flees from hundreds of Spider-People, but is sent to Earth-42, the world his spider came from, where he never got powers and his alternate self is the Prowler. The film ends on a cliffhanger as Gwen assembles a team to rescue him. (It includes live-action clips of Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield, a line blaming "Doctor Strange and the little nerd" for multiverse damage (meaning Holland's Peter), Donald Glover as a live-action Prowler, and a cameo by Mrs. Chen from the Venom films.)
credits: None.

entries.title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
entries.label: What is known
entries.story: The conclusion of the animated trilogy, picking up from Across the Spider-Verse's cliffhanger with Miles trapped on Earth-42 and Gwen's team on the way. The plot and credit scenes have not been revealed.

entries.title: Venom
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Eddie Brock, a reporter in San Francisco, loses his job and his fiancée Anne Weying after confronting Carlton Drake, the head of the Life Foundation, about deadly human experiments. Drake's company has brought back alien life forms called symbiotes from space, and they need human hosts to survive. Eddie sneaks into the lab and bonds with a symbiote named Venom, which gives him super strength, healing and a voice in his head with a craving for eating heads. Drake bonds with Riot, the symbiotes' leader, who plans to fly a rocket back to space and bring an invasion fleet to Earth. Venom decides he likes Earth and Eddie, and the two destroy Riot's rocket. Eddie and Venom stay together, agreeing to eat only "bad guys."
credits: Mid-credits: Eddie interviews imprisoned serial killer Cletus Kasady (Woody Harrelson) at San Quentin prison, who promises "there's gonna be carnage."
Post-credits: An extended clip from the animated film Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

entries.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Eddie's interviews with Cletus Kasady help police find his victims' bodies, sending Kasady to death row. At their last meeting, Kasady bites Eddie and swallows a piece of the symbiote, which grows into a new, more violent symbiote: Carnage. Meanwhile, Eddie and Venom fight like an old married couple and split up. Kasady escapes and frees his childhood love Frances Barrison (Shriek), whose sonic scream can hurt symbiotes. Eddie and Venom make up and stop Carnage and Shriek at a church on the night of the couple's wedding; Venom eats Carnage, and Shriek dies. Eddie and Venom hide out on a beach in Mexico.
credits: Mid-credits: In a Mexican hotel room, Venom starts telling Eddie about the knowledge his kind shares across universes, when a flash of light suddenly transports them into the main Marvel universe. On the television, J. Jonah Jameson is revealing that Peter Parker (Tom Holland) is Spider-Man. (This leads directly into the mid-credits scene of Spider-Man: No Way Home.)

entries.title: Morbius
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Dr. Michael Morbius, a brilliant scientist born with a rare, deadly blood disease, tries to cure himself with the DNA of vampire bats. It works too well: he gains super strength, flight, echolocation and an uncontrollable thirst for human blood. His adoptive brother Milo, who has the same illness, steals the formula and becomes a murderous vampire who enjoys his new power. Milo kills Morbius's colleague and love interest Martine, who bites Morbius as she dies. Morbius kills Milo with an antidote and flies off with a swarm of bats, now a fugitive.
credits: Mid-credits 1: The sky glows purple, and Adrian Toomes, the Vulture from Spider-Man: Homecoming (Michael Keaton), appears in a prison cell in Morbius's world, pulled there by the side effects of Doctor Strange's spell in No Way Home. He is soon released.

Mid-credits 2: Toomes, wearing a new Vulture suit, finds Morbius and suggests they team up. (This was meant to set up a "Sinister Six" team of villains, which was never made, and no later film explains it.)

entries.title: Madame Web
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Cassandra "Cassie" Webb, a paramedic in New York, nearly drowns and begins having visions of the future. She learns that her mother was researching rare spiders in the Amazon when she was killed by Ezekiel Sims, a man who stole the research and gained spider powers. Ezekiel has visions of being killed by three young Spider-Women and is hunting the teenage girls who will become them: Julia Cornwall, Anya Corazon and Mattie Franklin. Cassie protects the girls, and Ezekiel is killed by a falling Pepsi sign during the final fight. Cassie is left blind and paralyzed but with much stronger psychic powers, becoming Madame Web. (Ben Parker appears, and Peter Parker's birth happens off-screen, but there is no Spider-Man and no link to any other film.)
credits: None.

entries.title: Venom: The Last Dance
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Back in their own universe after No Way Home, Eddie and Venom are wanted by the police and by the military, led by General Strickland of the secret base Area 55. Worse, Knull, the dark god who created the symbiotes and is imprisoned in the void, is sending monsters called Xenophages to find the "Codex," a key that only exists while Eddie and Venom are bonded together. On the run across the American Southwest, Eddie and Venom hitch a ride with an alien-obsessed hippie family and are helped by scientist Dr. Teddy Paine. At Area 55, the captured symbiotes bond with soldiers and fight the Xenophages, and Venom sacrifices himself in a vat of acid to destroy the Codex forever, saving Eddie and Earth. Eddie ends up alone in New York, looking at the Statue of Liberty.
credits: Mid-credits: Knull, still imprisoned in his throne room, rises and vows revenge now that Venom is gone.
Post-credits: In the ruined lab, a cockroach crawls toward a vial that may contain leftover symbiote goo.
notes: Knull was set up as a big future villain, but with Sony's universe on hold, this has not been followed up.

entries.title: Kraven the Hunter
entries.label: Story
entries.story: Young Sergei Kravinoff, son of a brutal Russian crime boss named Nikolai, is mauled by a lion and saved by a mystical potion given to him by a girl named Calypso, which gives him the strength, speed and senses of a predator. As an adult, Sergei rejects his father's world and becomes a vigilante "hunter" who kills poachers and criminals. A gangster, Aleksei Sytsevich (who becomes the Rhino), and an assassin known as the Foreigner kidnap Sergei's gentle half-brother Dmitri. Sergei rescues him, kills Rhino and finally his own father. In a final twist, Dmitri reveals himself as the master of disguise Chameleon.
credits: None.

entries.title: WandaVision
entries.label: Story
meta: Aired: January 15 to March 5, 2021 · 9 episodes · Phase 4 · Set in: 2023, about three weeks after Avengers: Endgame · Watch after: Avengers: Endgame
entries.story: Wanda Maximoff and Vision are living a perfect married life in the town of Westview, New Jersey, inside a black-and-white 1950s sitcom, which changes to a new television decade with every episode. But Vision died in Infinity War, and the truth slowly emerges: overwhelmed by grief, Wanda has trapped the whole town inside a reality she controls, recreating Vision from her own power and even giving birth to twin sons, Billy and Tommy. Outside, Monica Rambeau (the girl from Captain Marvel, now grown up) and the space agency S.W.O.R.D. investigate, while its director Tyler Hayward secretly rebuilds the real Vision's body as a colorless "White Vision" weapon. Wanda's nosy neighbor "Agnes" turns out to be Agatha Harkness, a centuries-old witch who wants Wanda's power and reveals that Wanda is the legendary Scarlet Witch. Wanda defeats Agatha and traps her inside the "Agnes" persona, then lets the town go, which makes her version of Vision and her sons vanish. White Vision gets his memories back from the sitcom Vision and flies away.
credits: Episode 7 (mid-credits): Monica finds Agatha's basement lair and is caught.
Episode 8 (mid-credits): Hayward activates the White Vision.
Episode 9 (mid-credits): A Skrull disguised as an FBI agent tells Monica that a friend of her mother's wants to meet her in space. (This leads to Secret Invasion and The Marvels.)

Episode 9 (post-credits): Hiding in a mountain cabin, Wanda studies the evil Darkhold book in her spirit form while hearing her sons calling for help. (This leads directly into Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.)

entries.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
entries.label: Story
meta: Aired: March 19 to April 23, 2021 · 6 episodes · Phase 4 · Set in: 2024, six months after Endgame · Watch after: WandaVision
entries.story: Sam Wilson feels unworthy of Steve Rogers's shield and hands it to the government, which promptly gives it to soldier John Walker as the new Captain America. Sam and Bucky Barnes, now in therapy for his years as the Winter Soldier, reluctantly team up to chase the Flag Smashers, a group of super soldiers led by Karli Morgenthau who are fighting governments that push people displaced by the Blip out of their homes. They break Helmut Zemo (the villain of Civil War) out of prison for help and reunite with Sharon Carter, now a fugitive. Sam meets Isaiah Bradley, a Black super soldier from the Korean War whom the government imprisoned and experimented on, and struggles with what it means for a Black man to carry the shield. Walker takes the super soldier serum and publicly kills a Flag Smasher with the shield, losing the title, and is recruited by the mysterious Valentina Allegra de Fontaine as "U.S. Agent." Sam takes up the shield and a new suit, becomes Captain America, saves world leaders from the Flag Smashers, and Karli dies.
credits: Episode 5 (mid-credits): Walker forges his own new shield.
Episode 6 (mid-credits): A pardoned Sharon Carter returns to the Central Intelligence Agency, and is revealed as the "Power Broker," a black-market boss planning to sell government secrets.

entries.title: Loki, Season 1
entries.label: Story
meta: Aired: June 9 to July 14, 2021 · 6 episodes · Phase 4 · Set in: outside of time · Watch after: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (and you must have seen Endgame)
entries.story: The 2012 version of Loki, who escaped with the Tesseract during the time heist in Endgame, is arrested by the Time Variance Authority, a bureaucracy outside time that "prunes" anyone who strays from the one approved timeline, the Sacred Timeline. Agent Mobius recruits him to hunt a dangerous "variant" (an alternate version) of Loki who is attacking the agency, and she turns out to be Sylvie, a female Loki. Loki and Sylvie fall for each other and discover that the agency's god-like Time-Keepers are fake robots and that its agents are kidnapped variants with their memories erased. After being banished to the Void, a dumping ground at the end of time full of other Lokis, they reach the Citadel at the End of Time and meet He Who Remains, the man behind it all, who warns that his own evil variants (versions of Kang) would wage a multiversal war if he dies. Sylvie kills him anyway, the timeline splits into a multiverse of branching realities, and Loki returns to an agency where no one recognizes him and a statue of Kang now stands.
credits: Episode 4 (mid-credits): Loki wakes up in the Void and meets four other Lokis: Classic Loki, Kid Loki, Boastful Loki and Alligator Loki.
Episode 6: The end of the finale stamps "Loki will return in season 2."

entries.title: Hawkeye
entries.label: Story
meta: Aired: November 24 to December 22, 2021 · 6 episodes · Phase 4 · Set in: Christmas 2024 · Watch after: Eternals (it needs the Black Widow post-credits scene)
entries.story: Clint Barton just wants to spend Christmas in New York with his kids, until he sees news footage of a young archer wearing his old "Ronin" suit (the masked vigilante he became during the five years after the snap). She is Kate Bishop, a wealthy 22-year-old archery prodigy who has idolized Clint since he saved her life during the Battle of New York. The suit puts her in the crosshairs of the Tracksuit Mafia, its deaf leader Maya Lopez (Echo, whose father the Ronin killed), and Yelena Belova, who has been told Clint killed her sister Natasha. Kate's mother Eleanor turns out to be working for the crime boss behind it all: Wilson Fisk, the Kingpin (Vincent D'Onofrio, from the Netflix Daredevil show). Clint tells Yelena the truth about Natasha's sacrifice, Kate defeats Fisk, and Maya is heard shooting him off-screen. Clint passes the "Hawkeye" name on to Kate.
credits: Episode 6 (mid-credits): The full "Save the City" musical number from the in-universe Broadway show "Rogers: The Musical."

entries.title: Moon Knight
entries.label: Story
meta: Aired: March 30 to May 4, 2022 · 6 episodes · Phase 4 · Set in: 2025 · Watch after: Spider-Man: No Way Home (but it can be watched at any time; it has no links to the Avengers)
entries.story: Steven Grant, a shy gift-shop worker at a London museum, keeps losing time and waking up in strange places, until he discovers he shares his body with an American mercenary, Marc Spector, who serves as the "avatar" (the earthly fist) of the Egyptian moon god Khonshu. Cult leader Arthur Harrow, Khonshu's former avatar, is trying to free the crocodile goddess Ammit, who would judge and kill people for crimes they have not yet committed. Marc's wife Layla, who did not know about Steven, joins the hunt across Egypt. After being shot, Marc and Steven find themselves in a psychiatric hospital that is really the afterlife, where the hippo goddess Taweret helps them face the childhood trauma that caused their split. They return to life, Layla becomes the Scarlet Scarab, and Ammit is sealed inside Harrow's body.
